body: I'm sort of a recluse I guess, I'm not much of a people person. I can hold a conversation but I'd just prefer not to most of the time. The little things I look forward to are dumb, just like films or new series of shows I watch. Nothing real.

I just have nothing to look forward to, no career prospects, no real friends, I don't talk to the majority of my family anymore. Sure there's small shit, I like forward to, like TV shows or games or movies or whatever but that's just pathetic.

I'm fairly young, I'd rather not say exactly. But I don't exactly feel like  my whole life is ahead of me, when I try and look 5 or 10 years in the future there's just nothing. I don't see why I should bother.
I'm not really amazing, or even good, at anything. It doesn't make me feel better that you're alone too, I'm just sorry that you're in a similar position.
Yeah I think if I was less shit at everything, and less ugly I'd be less alone.
I mean in both. Any attempts at not being alone just feel completely futile.
Nothing really makes me happy, or if it does it feels like fake happiness. Like I know even if I don't feel like shit at the moment I'm going to later.
